_about: Shared by the browser sim and the motor bridge. Angles in degrees, lengths in mm. Restart the bridge after editing.

geometry._note: The upper arm and forearm are not in the CAD yet; these are assumed placeholder links. Shoulder height and lateral offsets come from web/meshes/manifest.json (tools/split_assembly.py).

mass_kg._note: elbow_motor is the published IM6014 mass. Links and payload are guesses; set them from your parts before enabling gravity_ff.

bus._note: All three IDs on one RS-485 channel by default. A joint may set its own "port" to use another FT4232H channel.
